pr.title: feat: pluggable auth providers — add AT Protocol, refactor GitHub/Google

report.summary: This PR introduces a pluggable auth-provider system (AuthProviderDescriptor, a `virtual:emdash/auth-providers` Vite module, generic route injection, dynamic public routes, and a shared `findOrCreateOAuthUser()` helper) and adds a new `@emdash-cms/plugin-atproto` provider, while refactoring GitHub/Google into descriptors and unifying the login page and setup wizard. It also bundles a large amount of unrelated work (repeater field component, i18n/locale infrastructure, CSP middleware, sitemap/search/media changes, many changesets). Reviewers should focus on the auth flow correctness (callback/setup-admin, allowlist verification, session establishment, signup gating) and on the new admin components such as RepeaterField, since the diff is enormous and mixes many concerns. The patch context provided here only exposes `packages/admin/src/components/RepeaterField.tsx` and its tests, so the findings below are limited to that file.
